items.text: Wesley and I are praying for our friend @SteveScalise as he begins his course of treatment. He’s shown that there is no challenge that he can’t overcome and I know he’ll defeat this cancer and be back on the House Floor soon!

Proud to secure critical funding that supports our rural hospitals and protect Medicaid benefits for those in need who the program is intended to serve.

🏥 Strengthening and preserving health care programs and hospitals.

✅ $500 million secured for Alabama's 54 rural hospitals.
✅ Medicaid Provider Tax frozen at 6% for non-expansion states, like Alabama.
✅ Commonsense work requirements for Medicaid.

The Rural Health Transformation Fund in the One Big Beautiful Bill will invest over $500 million into Alabama’s rural health care providers. This funding will strengthen our rural hospitals and ensure they can continue to provide critical services for our local communities.

In addition to strengthening and preserving important programs like Medicaid, I fought hard to make sure Alabama’s rural hospitals were prioritized—securing over $500 million to support care where it’s needed most. 

This funding will be life-changing for families across our state.

1.2 MILLION people were enrolled in government healthcare programs in multiple states last year, costing taxpayers up to $14 BILLION annually. 

https://t.co/YpJSF3Ci51

Mainstream media and the Left continue spreading misinformation about Medicaid. This fearmongering and dishonesty are dangerous.
 
Let’s set the record straight - Republicans are strengthening and preserving this important safety net program. 🧵
The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services have found that 2.8 MILLION people are potentially enrolled in two or more duplicative government health programs, wasting $14 BILLION annually.

Americans overwhelmingly believe there should be work requirements for able-bodied adults to receive Medicaid benefits. Republicans heeded that call.
 
Commonsense work requirements will save $344 BILLION over ten years.

Hardworking taxpayers have been supporting stay-at-home sons for far too long. Democrats supported this out-of-control spending, which put Medicaid on an unsustainable path. Republicans are right-sizing Medicaid to ensure those who truly need support have access now and for generations to come.

Democrats turned Medicaid from a safety net into a hammock. It should be protected for our most vulnerable, and under President Trump’s leadership, hardworking taxpayers will no longer foot the bill for able-bodies adults sitting around at home.  
 
Here’s the bottom line: Republicans are working to save Medicaid, so our most vulnerable citizens receive the care they deserve.
Republicans strengthened and preserved Medicaid to ensure this safety net is there for the Americans who truly need it—not just now, but for generations to come. https://t.co/TzJ0niv3e3

Great news. Expanding access to quality health care starts with making it easier for doctors to serve patients across our state. 

I’ll continue to fight to improve health outcomes in every corner of Alabama.
